div.head: Ger 16[a]
div.ab: [16[a]] And gif he smeawyrhtan hæfð, ðam he sceal to tolan fylstan: mylewerde, sutere, leodgotan 7 oðran wyrhtan –
And gif he smeawyrhtan hæfð . ðam he sceal to tolan fylstan . Mylewerde, Sutere . Leodgotan. 7 oðran wyrhtan.
And gif he smeawyrhtan hæfð, ðam he sceal to tolan fylstan—mylewerde, sutere, leodgotan and oðran wyrhtan.
And if he has skilled artisans, he must supply tools to them, miller, shoe maker, plumber and other workers.
And if he has skilled workmen, then he must provide them with tools—miller, shoemaker, plumber, and other laborers.
Und wenn er Feinarbeiter [Handwerker] hat, denen muss er zu Werkzeugen verhelfen, dem Müller, Schuster, Bleigiesser [Klempner] und anderen Arbeitern —
And if he has skilled workmen [craftsmen], he must help them to tools, the miller, the shoemaker, the lead-worker [plumber] and other workmen —
div.note: Liebermann's 16 is split here into two rows. K: a stray bracket removed. B's ‘mylewerde’ is unclear (n or u). Liebermann compares Gerefa 9.
Rabin’s 16 covers the rows 16[a], 16[b]; it is given here, in the first.
